---
kind: [[failure]]
level: warn
remedies: ["Run git switch main, and take a finished cloud branch in with ./RUNME.sh branch merge <name>."]
---

# When

A desk lands work on a work branch.

cases.name: a commit with an empty delta meets the git write door
cases.command: git commit -m "the door reads the change"
cases.text:
Level zero refuses this command.

  ran: git commit -m "the door reads the change"

  GitWritesThroughAVerb
    reads: git commit
    git commit writes the repository, and the agent reaches git through the engine alone. Land the change through ./RUNME.sh commit, which stages, commits and runs the check.

Hold GitWritesThroughAVerb for the rest of this turn.

cases.name: a desk commit on the trunk refuses through the verb
cases.command: git commit -m "the door reads the change"
cases.text:
This commit lands on main past the commit verb.

Run `./RUNME.sh commit "<message>"`, which reads the message, runs the tests,
commits, runs the check and pushes the branch you stand on. One helper's work
rides one commit, so one review reads it and one undo takes it back.

cases.name: a desk push of the trunk on a red battery refuses
cases.command: git push origin main
cases.text:
main takes a green battery, and no check has run here.

Run `./RUNME.sh check` last, after your final commit. The stamp names
the commit it ran against, so a commit after it reads stale.

cases.name: a desk push of the trunk on a green battery refuses through the verb
cases.command: git push origin main
cases.text:
This push lands on main past the push verb.

Run `./RUNME.sh push`, which reads the check's stamp and pushes the branch
you stand on once the check answers green on it.

cases.name: a desk push of the trunk on a stale stamp refuses
cases.command: git push origin main
cases.text:
main takes a green battery, and the check ran against 01234567.

Run `./RUNME.sh check` last, after your final commit. The stamp names
the commit it ran against, so a commit after it reads stale.

cases.name: a cloud push of the trunk off a work branch refuses
cases.command: git push origin main
cases.text:
A cloud box holding a work branch hands it back, and main stays shut here.

This pushes main, and the branch in hand goes back to the queue instead.

Run `./RUNME.sh ticket pull`, which takes a branch for a cloud box and moves you onto it.
Push that branch, run `branch done`, and a box off the cloud takes it into trunk.
